_comment: Hyperlink color regression: each case is a text run on a surface. check_hyperlink_colors.py builds one slide from this file, exports it with LibreOffice (export_office.py) and samples the rendered text pixels. 'expect' is the color the text must render in; 'known_bad' marks the case that reproduces the bug (an explicit gold link color rendered as link blue on navy). theme_hlink is the hyperlink color of the ATR templates' theme (assets/templates/*.pptx, ppt/theme/theme1.xml), which LibreOffice uses for run hyperlinks.

cases.note: The bug: a run hyperlink with an explicit gold color. LibreOffice draws it in the theme hyperlink color, #1D65B9 (about 2.0:1 on navy).
The same run hyperlink on white: the explicit navy is also replaced by #1D65B9 (readable on white, but not the color that was set).
Run hyperlink with the Office 2019 hlinkClr val="tx" extension (use the text color).
Recommended fix: the printed fallback is plain text (no hyperlink); the QR picture carries the link.
The link on the text box itself (click action), not on the run: the run keeps its color.
